avis.titre: Excellent product- have been using for a year
avis.texte: I love reusable silicone undereye patches so I knew I had to try this forehead patch. I've probably gotten close to 50 uses (maybe more) and am just now repurchasing again. After I use it with one of my serums (of which I have many), my forehead lines always look reduced, healthy and hydrated. Much better than using a one-time use face mask.

I loved this so much I bought a whole face collection. I've had them for about 3 years and they are still tacky and effective. My one complaint is they're a little thick which makes them heavy, and I think they would stay in place better if they were a little thinner.

avis.titre: Wear All Night & Say Goodbye to 11s!
avis.texte: I'm 49 and have struggled with the "forehead 11" for a couple of years. They look particularly awful when I wake up in the morning because apparently I furrow my brow while sleeping. I started wearing this patch all night long and it prevents me from furrowing my brow in my sleep. The 11s look so much better - like fine lines and not deep ones. I can't live without this! I wish they were more affordable as I typically have to replace them about every 4-6 weeks.

I bought it back in June, I tried it once and was not sure if it was going to stay on and it felt strange having it on. I forgot about it for a few months. Then in October I noticed my forehead wrinkles were getting more noticeable. I decided to give it a try again and this time I applied my nightly face routine and make sure my forehead was moisturized. I placed it on and kept pressing on it to create a suction for it to stay on. It stayed on all night and I noticed a big difference in the morning. I've been using it for 3 days straight. I can see a difference and I will keep on using it. I will say I clean it with some mild soap and water right after I take it off and leave it to air drive before I put it back in the case. I think that helps with keeping that stickiness.
definitely have to use it daily to really see the difference. I wash with dial soap and spray with alcohol to keep sticky but the edges have gone a bit even with care. still stays on despite that.

I was hopeful but skeptical when buying this product. After trying it for a few days, I'm very happy with the results! I wear it overnight, and I start the day with a line-free forehead! It works better and better the more consistently you use it. I forgot to wear ir one night, and i was shocked seeing the difference… i haven't forgotten sonce then! I apply Good Molecules Super Peptide Serum before applying the mask, and its a match made in Heaven. Try it out!

I was hopeful but skeptical when buying this product. After trying it for a few days, I'm very happy with the results! I wear it overnight, and I start the day with a line-free forehead! It works better and better the more consistently you use it. I forgot to wear ir one night, and i was shocked seeing the difference… i haven't forgotten sonce then! I apply Good Molecules Super Peptide Serum before applying the mask, and its a match made in Heaven. Try it out!
I love how cute these are and they stick really well, even with serum on my face. not sure if they make a difference yet but I like them so far.

avis.titre: Stays in place and very affective
avis.texte: I'm so glad I got this. It stays in place while I do laundry.

avis.titre: works best on clean dry skin
avis.texte: in contrast with the instructions, I use this on freshly washed and dried skin so it sticks for a longer period of time. I'm in my mid 30s and just starting to get fine lines that stick around for longer than I like, but this temporarily smooths them out and would help if I was consistent. I just wish the silicone was a little bit thinner as I think that would help it not lift at the parameter and that it was transparent. I have a pretty large forehead so I haven't needed to trim this. I really like taking it on trips where I have to fly because my skin is so dehydrated afterwards and this helps plump up the skin on my forehead, then I moisturize as usual

avis.titre: I give it an honest 3 stars
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple of months now. I apply my night cream, retinol and then the patch. It works well, but it doesn't stick well enough between my eyes, which is disappointing. I use the eye patches too. They don't fall off at night and I've had no problem after washing them repeatedly with a mild soap.

I swear I washed this thing so thoroughly, but I've used it 3 times now, each with a different serum that I've used before as a part of my normal nighttime routine, and all 3 times I woke up with the worst rashy mess all over my forehead. I really wanted to love this, I think the stickiness just irritated my skin way too much.

It lost its stickiness after my second use even when I washed as directed. I have a very oily forehead so maybe that's why. I wouldn't recommend if you have oily skin. It did help with my lines when I was able to use it.

I've had this reusable mask for about 6 months and it keeps wanting to fall off now. I've washed and dried it like the instructions said but I think I might have to throw it away at this point cuz it keeps wanting to fall off my face.
The directions say to use your serum that you normally use at night, then apply mask. The spot between brows just did not stick. I had to keep pressing it down.

I noticed wrinkles/11 lines on my forehead since I'm a stomach sleeper. I started using this patch overnight, and it is a GAME CHANGER!! In addition to preventing forehead lines, it also locks in my moisturizer. The patch lasts for a few months! 5/5

I was skeptical of this product, as I have been using Frownies for a while and read everywhere that nothing compares. This totally does though, and it's reusable which is great! I've been using it for 2 weeks now pretty much daily and it sticks just as well as it did the first time I used it. As long as you wash it and let it dry according to the instructions it remains sticky. I've noticed my forehead lines are reduced and it helps my skin absorb the hyaluronic acid gel I use underneath.
Great product overall. I have seen people say it doesn't stick but mine has so far. I only use water and my fingers to rinse it though and let it air dry in the tin during the day. Great product!

Using any drops with this mask, it will slip off in your sleep. If you use it on dry skin, it will stay on. It's unfortunate because I like using anti aging serums but that makes this patch slip around and fall right off. Bummer.

I've only used this once so far, so grain of salt, but I was truly surprised at how well this worked. I've seen so many reviews saying it didn't work or stay on, but that wasn't my experience. It stayed on all night (and I slept on my back, side, and belly) and my forhead lines were basically non-existent by morning. I use the YTTP Retinal serum and combining it with this just ironed out my fine lines. For reference, I'm 34 and have some very fine horizontal lines, but no 11 lines.
These literally work. It made me feel like my lines on my forehead went away.

Wanted a sustainable frownies dupe to diminish my 11s. But this is SO poorly designed. Why use this thick cushiony material that doesn't sit flat??? Useless on its own - with a sleep mask over it to hold it in place it sorta works, but not really.

so I used this a few months ago. the first time I used it I tried to put just enough peptide serum underneath it. I followed the directions so that it would still stick but I did have product under it. I took it off after probably 20 minutes and noticed a red mark on my forehead. after a few months the red mark is still not gone. it is noticeable and I am frustrated. I personally think you're going to get better results from just using a sheet mask. I wanted to use a peptide serum with mine so I would just replace it with a peptide sheet mask.

avis.titre: Have not found anything similar but the sides curl
avis.texte: I really like this and have looked for something like this. I have used reusable eye masks like this but needed something for forehead lines and to hold my serums close to the skin rather than always buying sheet masks. And to use more often. I found this and like it, but the sides dont always stay stuck to my head and will lift up. Otherwise though it sticks well and I have never had it fall off or almost fall off. But the corners do curl up and do not stay against the skin. I am small though and have a thin face. Does the job

I don't always have time for a sheet mask, so I gave this brow mask a try during my morning coffee routine. Paired with cocokind ceramide serum, I had noticably smoother frown lines after wearing for just about an hour. I had no terrible getting these to stick and they were ready to clean and dry. the tin to keep it in it's really nice too.

I see a lot if reviews saying this doesn't stick and dalls right off- I had that issue too cause I know the directions say to apply a tiny amount of your moisturizer- but I recommend not to! I usually do it right after washing my face and then after using the mask I'll do my regimen. It sticks for a very long and the results are really nice. I wish it was a permanent fix for my 11 lines lol

avis.titre: This is not a product,  it's a tool
avis.texte: Of used with an effective serum, this will change your skin. It will definitely prevent in the long run.

I honestly did not expect much from this becuz I use face masks often and don't usually get instant results. BUT, if I sleep with this on, it actually gives me noticable results by morning. I do my normal skincare routine and then put this on my forehead just before lights out. By morning, the cpl of wrinkles on my forehead are significantly reduced! I'm a stomach sleeper so there are nights that it doesn't stay on until morning, but overall, I've really enjoyed using this

avis.titre: I would buy these masks again and again
avis.texte: These silicone masks take a little getting used to but they work I wear them overnight I apply them after my night serum has absorbed my forehead is completely smooth in the morning
I love this. It is so easy and it stays on well for me. Easy to clean as well

I love this. I love Pacifica products. But this really works. You don't need much product underneath. I use a few drops of various serums on my forehead and leave the patch on until it feels fully absorbed and my forehead lines always look plump, hydrated and the lines have become less noticeable when I remove it. It really helps get the full effect of whatever serums you're using.
I'm on my tenth use of it right now. This bb stays PUT The tin is nice too; I appreciate the air holes.
How do people get these to stick. I used it once and now it doesn't stick. followed directions to the letter.

Idk what people are talking about it not sticking through the night. If you aren't washing it after each application maybe? But it takes two second to run some soap and water over it in the morning, and then by the time it's time to use it again it's still as sticky as ever. I wear a silk eye mask at night as well so maybe that helps it not move much, but even when my mask slips off at night, it stays on. I wash my face, moisturize, and then put on the product. I feel like it's helped greatly!

These stick very well to my skin, barely move even with serum underneath. Promotes extra hydration with the serum I use (also Pacifica brand). They are easy to clean and the case comes with ventilation so no mold can begin to grow if they aren't entirely dry when I put them back in. Great product!

I was hoping for a better quality product, it claimed to be vacuum sealed but upon first application it already feels like it will loose it's stick. It does feel nice but overall it doesn't do as advertised.

If this thing was "reusable" like it's called it would honestly work wonders. I successfully used the for 1 night in total and I do have to say the 11 lines that I normally get were much more subtle than ever before the day after my first use. But from the second night to the 5th night this would easily fall off. After 4 nights of this now falling off and no longer providing any results I decided to give up on this and return. Don't waste your money
On the first application it has a good sticky backing. But on the first application even after making sure it was presses down well, the 3 corners would come up and not even be touching the skin.

I've only used this twice so far but am really happy with how well it stays on and feels soft and comfortable. So far I'm seeing similar results to single use masks - i.e., good for a quick hydrate or plump, not sure if there will be any long term benefits. Am hoping to get more than 10 uses out of it, although it's cheaper and hopefully more sustainable than single use, it's still a bit pricey to keep buying over and over. Hope they sell a "refill" pack (maybe at a lower price?) - I like the metal tin for storage but I definitely don't need to keep accumulating tins.
Wanted a reusable option for frownies but this just isn't it. Doesn't stay on throughout the night at all. Just save your money and use tape.

I tried to use this overnight after applying some serum and letting it dry. It wasn't very sticky after the first use and fell off while I was sleeping. I followed the directions and tried cleaning the sticky side but that didn't help and may have made it worse. I wouldn't buy again or recommend. I use Frownies instead and I wish they were reusable but at least they stay on very firmly all night.
This is the best silicone patch I've ever used. It sticks for at least 15 uses. I didn't use soap to clean it just warm water and then let it air dry.
I was using the amazing cheap adhesive but this one last forever ( 20days) and give even more results. The problem is that is too expensive.

This is a great little skincare tool! I'm an esthi and I'm always looking for ways to prevent aging and plump the skin that are gentle and noninvasive. It's a pretty thick patch that can be work throughout the day or overnight and leaves the skin smooth and younger looking! It is a temporary fix but it's still a great addition to my routine. It's very sticky so make sure to pull all hair back but dont worry! it won't remove eyebrow hairs! I have a pretty small forehead so it does go over my brows and hairline a bit but it's still pretty comfortable. I do recommend rinsing in COOL water only! Mine has held up for about a month and I'm barely noticing some minor wear in the silicone :)

avis.titre: I will NOT buy this again
avis.texte: You would have to sleep flat on your back or else they come off as you move around in sleep.
I'm still trying this out however you must sleep on your back or they come off also the brow mask itches underneath and not sure why but probably won't keep using after it's worn out.

I was skeptical but once I saw this on sale I figured it was a good time to try. After 3 uses I could honestly already see a difference. I will for sure keep using this! (Also easy to clean and store in the aluminum case)

I've reused this for at least a month (maybe two) and still having great results. I mainly wear it to bed and it stays all night. Clean with soap and water in morning. I can feel my forehead learning to tighten when I use it consistently in a row. Can't wait to try eye patches.
I purchased with the intent to chill them in the fridge/ freezer and use when I have headaches. I'll update after I've been using long term to see how they hold up….
I was bummed. I didn't see any difference on my forehead. I even left it on overnight.
I used it for the first time and it doesnt stay down on my skin on the ends or in between the eyebrows but other than that i love the concept

I apply the silicone patch on clean dry skin. I used this product on my chest. It did temporarily helped with the wrinkles. As I applied it for an hour. Some did appear to come back. I would recommend keeping it overnight to get the long term effect.
This product is a miracle. I wear it when it sleep and it helps my forehead wrinkles!

I read someone else's review that said it only sticks with certain products, and I've found that to be true. I have a retinol stick that this does not work with, but so far it has worked with my liquid retinol and other serums. I try to apply this before things dry down too much. The very edges have trouble sticking sometimes but the majority is good. I cut a small slit in the top center so it would curve to my face better. I can tell a difference in the morning after wearing, but too soon to speak for any long term effects. Once it is applied, I find it easy to sleep in.
What a waste. I can't believe all the positive reviews. Used once and the ends keep folding up and I didn't use a lot of serum for my face. Move on to other product to save your hard earned money.

it does stay on but it doesn't stick like the first time I used them :( I've been using it for 2 weeks and I sleep with it. I love it bc when I wake up my faint forehead wrinkle doesn't show. I have to use a headband to keep it secure. Also, it's very big for my small forehead. I say buy it on sale!
it was great the first night, but after that it didn't stick anymore. def overhyped, i will just be going back to b*t*x (apparently you can't put that word in a review lol)

avis.titre: Stays on like it says and seems to work well
avis.texte: I was getting horizontal forehead lines I didn't like, and I thought this was worth a shot, particularly because I was pretty sure looking annoyed at my computer while working was part of the problem. This not only helps my peptide serum absorb it keeps me from scrunching my forehead while I work. It stays on, and seems to stay sticky even after several washes. I'm pretty impressed with this mask. I just wish I could sleep in it to prevent sleep scrunching, but I use retinoids, and occlusive stuff isn't recommended with prescription tret, plus I'd miss my much needed moisturizer. I'd bet it would stay on just fine though!

avis.titre: Decent for my neck lines but not sticky enough?
avis.texte: I'm actually wearing this upside down on my neck and it fits like a champ. The only issue is that this stickiness of the mask will wear off like it did with the "smile lines" version after 2 uses.
I've used expensive silicone patches in the passed and have LOVED them but these are just as good and half the price AND super adorable. Love these!

I am so impressed at how it stays put and makes my skin feel so firm after. I slept with mine last night and again tonight. I put several serums including the wake up beautiful and cream and allow it to absorb before placing this. If you over handle it with your fingers and products, just put a bit of water and moisten the skin and it sticks very well like a suction cup. I have bought the under eye ones as well and saw results after one use. Very easy to clean and let air dry sticky side up in the cute tin. I am so glad I bought these!

I sleep with mine on and apply a peptide serum underneath to prevent dynamic wrinkles since I'm in my late 20s and wanna keep the nice skin I worked to achieve. I also love that it's medical grade silicone, as I am allergic to most adhesives but not this.
Really happy with this product. Keeps my brow in place so my forehead and 11 lines don't become more pronounced.
